title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Support Garment Quantity Share
content:
**Price-list term.** The support garment (code A4467 under revenue code 0274) on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is valued at its charges multiplied by its quantity share, which follows the quantity dispensed (its billed units) on Riverbend's take-home price list: 0.6 when 3 or more garment units are dispensed, 0.75 when 2 are dispensed, and 1 for a single unit.

*Questions answered (hypothetical charges of 80.00)*
- 2 garments: 80.00 times 0.75 → 60.00.
- 3 garments: 80.00 times 0.6 → 48.00.
- 1 garment: 80.00.
